title: Na na na nana na na nana na na

lyrics.text:
Na na na na
na na na na
na na na na

He made
the blind man see
He calmed
the stormy sea

He made
the lame man walk
So I believe
in God

When I hear
His mighty work
I know
His power is real

My faith, My hope
is in Him
so I believe in God
believe in God

Impossible is nothing
is nothing and
I do believe in You

Impossible is nothing
is nothing
All things are possible

Impossible is nothing
is nothing
when I put my trust in You

Impossible is nothing
is nothing
All things are possible
